title.full: What to do about an ICA scam call

summary.text: Ignore the call, share no personal or banking details, and report suspected fraud to the Police.

details.heading: Get scam advice
details.body: You can call the anti-scam centre for scam-related advice.

steps.name: Ignore the call
steps.text: Ignore the call and any instructions from the caller.

steps.name: Share no details
steps.text: Do not provide your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details.

steps.name: Report suspected fraud
steps.text: Report it to the Police if you suspect a fraudulent act or wrongdoing.

sources.page_title: What should I do if I suspect the call claiming to be from ICA to be a scam?

quotes.text: If you have reason to believe that the call is a scam, you are advised to take the following precautions:
Ignore such calls and the caller’s instructions
Do not provide personal information such as your name, identification number, passport details, contact details, or banking and credit card details
Report to Police if you suspect any fraudulent act or wrongdoing.
Members of the public can seek scam-related advice by calling the anti-scam centre at 1800-722-6688
